//: Lighthouse CI for the release gate (docs/RELEASE_GATE.md §14). Committed rather than typed on the command line, so two runs on two machines measure the same thing; the URLs come from the command line at run time.
//mobile: The mobile preset, not desktop. Mallok's users arrive on phones from search and from WhatsApp links, and a desktop run with desktop throttling is the easier test of the two — passing it says little about the request that actually happens.
//runs: Exactly three, and every one of them is kept: `scripts/lighthouse-gate.mjs` reads all three reports and asserts a minimum as well as a median. Lighthouse CI's own assertions compare the median only, which is why the floor is enforced outside them.

assert.//: The floor Lighthouse CI can express by itself: it asserts the median of the three runs. The per-run minimum and the higher median are asserted by scripts/lighthouse-gate.mjs, which reads the three reports.
